summary: Test suite covers basic cartesian product, include/exclude rules, and configuration flags, but has critical gaps: (1) GitHub Actions workflow requirement entirely missing—tests don't integrate with act/CI as mandated; (2) fixture files referenced but not provided (simple_config.json, full_config.json, etc.), making tests non-executable; (3) no edge-case testing (empty matrices, duplicates, boundary conditions, type validation); (4) hard-coded expected counts (4, 18) without fixture visibility or explanation; (5) brittle structure with no comments explaining assertions; (6) minimal error scenario coverage (only 4 validation tests for a 14-test suite). Would not catch regressions reliably and cannot run without missing pieces.
